Because defaultProps always injects `light`, the deprecation helper warns even when the user hasn’t set it explicitly. 1.bug_scenario: When rendering an <OverflowMenu> without ever passing a `light` prop, the console still emits a deprecation warning: “The `light` prop for `OverflowMenu` is no longer needed and has been deprecated…”. In our code we never set `light`, so the warning is spurious. It comes from the component’s own defaultProps and prop‐type deprecation helper treating the default field as a user‐supplied prop.
